newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SAN MIGUEL TUMBLES 5.74 PCT IN LATE TRAD.
newsitem.headline: SAN MIGUEL TUMBLES 5.74 PCT IN LATE TRAD.

text.p: San Miguel Corp's B shares dropped 3.50 pesos, or 5.74 percent, to 57.50 pesos on foreign selling in late Tuesday trade, brokers said.

"It's the same reason why other blue chips are lower. A lot of people are still concerned about the interest rate scenario even if it's declining," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Orion-Squire Capital.
"Foreigners are leaving Asia. The general sentiment is that they are out," said Allan Araullo, vice president at Regina Capital Development Corp.
San Miguel B shares were among the most heavily traded issues. It earlier reached a low of 57 pesos.
Other blue chip issues that were lower for most of the session were Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co, Manila Electric Co B and Petron Corp.
